svg.title: PV diagrams of a real substance
svg.desc: (a) Isotherms on a pressure–volume diagram for T₅ > T₄ > T₃ > T_c > T₂ > T₁. The upper curves are close to ideal-gas hyperbolas; below the critical temperature T_c each isotherm has a flat segment across a shaded dome, the liquid–vapor equilibrium region, with liquid to its left and vapor to its right. (b) An enlarged view near the critical point, at the top of the dome. The critical isotherm T_c just touches the dome there. To the left is the liquid region, under the dome the liquid–vapor region, to the right of the saturation curve the vapor region, and above, gas that is real but not ideal.
